query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('constraints', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name',tc.table_name,'column_name',kcu.column_name,'foreign_table',ccu.table_name,'foreign_column',ccu.column_name) ORDER BY tc.table_name,kcu.column_name) FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name=kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema=kcu.table_schema JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu ON ccu.constraint_name=tc.constraint_name AND ccu.table_schema=tc.table_schema WHERE tc.constraint_type='FOREIGN KEY' AND tc.table_schema='public' AND tc.table_name IN ('customer_favorites','merchant_favorites','favorite_couriers','courier_favorites','chat_conversations','chat_messages')), 'favorite_couriers', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT user_id,courier_id FROM public.favorite_couriers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) x), 'courier_favorites', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT courier_id,target_id,target_type FROM public.courier_favorites ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) x), 'merchant_favorites', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT merchant_id,target_id,target_type FROM public.merchant_favorites ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) x), 'customer_favorites', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT customer_id,target_id,target_type FROM public.customer_favorites ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) x)) AS audit
